title: Event
description: Envelope of every session-log event. Graph, run and node identity are required from the first event (design 06, Ring 0).

seq.description: Position in the session log: starts at 0, gap-free and strictly increasing.

at.description: UTC timestamp exactly as Date.prototype.toISOString() writes it (millisecond precision, `Z`), so string order is time order. No leap seconds.

payload.description: Event-type-specific body; typed per event kind by the object-model schemas.

id.description: Opaque identifier. A pattern rather than minLength keeps generated validators free of runtime imports.
